say: NozyWallet is a shielded-only Zcash wallet. Here's how to install it, receive, and send.
Add NozyWallet from the Chrome Web Store, or grab the latest release on GitHub.
Open it and pick NozyWallet sync. Your keys stay in the extension. You can also use your own Zebra node.
Tap Create and set a password. It encrypts the wallet on this device.
Write your 24 words down offline. Nobody can recover them for you. Then confirm a few to continue.
Your balance is split across the Orchard, Ironwood and Sapling pools.
Tap Receive for your u1 unified address. There are no transparent addresses in Nozy.
Payments to that address show up here once the wallet syncs. Our demo wallet is still empty.
With NozyWallet sync, sends go through the Nozy companion app on this computer. Paste an address, enter an amount, and add a memo if you like.
Tap Review and Nozy builds the shielded transaction in your browser. Fund the wallet first, or there's nothing to send.
Shielded transactions keep amounts, addresses and memos encrypted on chain. NozyWallet is open source on GitHub.
